verdict.rationale: Ashby's developer docs include a dedicated webhook setup page. It covers real-time callbacks for events such as candidate status changes, job posting updates and interview scheduling, and payloads can be verified with a secret-token digest in the `Ashby-Signature` header. The Slack alerts integration does not count toward this story. missing for 10: a complete enumerated event catalog, documented delivery/retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: A webhook is a way to notify you when certain events happen in Ashby.
Webhooks allow for real-time integration with Ashby's platform, enabling automated responses to events like candidate status changes, job posting updates, or interview scheduling.
The digest will be included in the request under the `Ashby-Signature` http header.
